entry_points.summary: Propagates targeted plan amendments consistently across plan artifacts.
Coordinates parallel multi-dimensional code auditing and rubric checks.
Seeds plan definitions via parallel ideation models and anti-bias passes.
Coordinates regression investigation, hypothesis isolation, and fix loops.
Applies small plan-free changes directly to source code under peer review.
Executes all pending task files using isolated implementer and reviewer subagents.
Implements the next pending plan task under code review safety gates.
Surfaces project infrastructure suggestions from run event logs.
Initializes the two-tier human and LLM concept documentation system.
Drift-checks and refreshes stale or drifted concept documentation.
Creates lightweight bug fix plans bypassing full subagent overhead.
Splits a large plan into parallel sub-planning sessions.
Executes the core planning pipeline creating spec, plan, and task files.
Explores a codebase and charts its constraints before defining a plan.
Validates the complete set of generated code diffs against spec requirements.
Safely mutates system plugin skill definitions.
Analyzes historical run logs to aggregate token metrics and run times.
Appends key lessons and edge case memories to concept documentation JSON.
Constructs rich semantic test-case plans to link within task items.

invariants: Every execution event must be routed to metrics.jsonl and per-run event logs.
Commands must handle the Z_HARNESS_SLUG environment variable to partition plan directories.
gotchas: Orchestrating large plans directly in the main thread is context-heavy; delegate to subagents.
